height_method_target: DSM minus DTM sampled inside official UrbIS building footprints
notes: The five currently materialized Ixelles cells occupy only the 149168 and 149169 UrbIS kilometre raster tiles. The four official DSM/DTM archives are SHA-256 recorded and their 0.5 m grids are aligned. Per-building p50/p75/p90 DSM-DTM statistics and confidence are now derived. No single runtime height has been selected yet: the next gate is to define and test a conservative height-selection policy, keep insufficient buildings explicit, and derive terrain/relief for the same five cells before any further geographic expansion.
